caption: The drawing depicts a square quilt with evenly spaced grid patterns containing sixteen individual rectangular blocks, each featuring a unique botanical or geometric motif. The quilt is bordered by a continuous decorative pattern of red flowers with green stems on a scalloped red arc, forming a frame around the central blocks. Each of the sixteen internal blocks shows intricate designs made up of green, red, and yellow elements, mostly arranged in symmetrical floral, leafy, or star-shaped patterns. The background color of the quilt is off-white, and there is white space between the blocks, which are separated by subtle stitched or drawn borders. The lower right corner of the image contains the artist's signature, "Suzanne Roy." The color palette consists mainly of red, green, yellow, and off-white, with the designs rendered using clear, deliberate lines and filled with solid colors and minimal shading.
title: Applique Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
